text:
jessica_customer: Hey team — I tried to apply the partner voucher at checkout and got "Code invalid or expired". It worked for another colleague earlier today. I'm in NZ (UTC+13) if that matters.

emma_support: sorry about that — can you DM the code and the email you used? I'll check the backend. :eyes:

jessica_customer: sent in DM: CODE-TRUST-APR2026, email jessica+trial@example.com. Order attempt 2026-04-03 23:45 NZDT.

emma_support: thx. Quick debug: promo-bot shows the code as active until 2026-04-03 23:59:59 but stored in DB as 2026-04-03T23:59:59-07:00 (PST). Hmm. @oliver_billing can you confirm if expiry is stored in UTC or local?

oliver_billing: looking now — the promo ingestion job writes expiry as a naive timestamp in the partner CSV (no timezone). Our promo importer assumes UTC by default. If partner interpreted end-of-day in their local time (PST) the effective expiry can shift for international users.

mike_engineer: quick repro in staging: calling /v1/promos/validate with payload {
  "code": "CODE-TRUST-APR2026",
  "account_email": "jessica+trial@example.com"
} returns {
  "valid": false,
  "reason": "expired",
  "expires_at": "2026-04-03T23:59:59-07:00"
}

james_infra: tagging the ingestion job logs: we have entries where partner csv had "2026-04-04" but no TZ; importer did strptime('%Y-%m-%d') and then .replace(tzinfo=UTC). So partner intended end-of-day in PST but we canonicalized to UTC midnight. That yields earlier expiry for users east of UTC.

emma_support: ah — so for a NZ user trying at 23:45 local, the code could already be treated as expired because of the timezone shift. Not a unicode/whitespace issue here.

jessica_customer: so is there anything you can do? My app needs that credit to finish onboarding tests.

oliver_billing: immediate remediation: we can issue a manual credit for that account for the equivalent value. I can do that right now if you confirm the account email.

jessica_customer: please, yes confirm and thanks.

oliver_billing: done — applied 50 USD credit to jessica+trial@example.com, note #TKT-4531. Sent confirmation email.

mike_engineer: short-term fix proposal: treat date-only expiries from partner CSV as end-of-day in partner tz if partner metadata contains tz field, otherwise default to partner account tz (not UTC). We'll also add a validation warning when CSV lacks tz. Will send PR.

emma_support: ETA for patch?

mike_engineer: I'll open a PR today for the importer (adds timezone parsing + tests). If no blockers could roll to staging in 48h, prod in ~5 business days.

james_infra: we'll also add monitoring: alert when >0.5% of promo validations fail with expired but recently active region/time clusters (so we catch timezone skew regressions).

emma_support: copying resolution back to customer and closing thread after billing confirms. Flags for docs: update KB entry about partner CSV timezone assumptions and add checklist for partners shipping date-only expiries.

jessica_customer: thanks all! appreciate the quick help :pray:

promo-bot: Automated note: manual credit applied by oliver_billing (50 USD) — ticket TKT-4531.

emma_support: closing thread — follow-ups: PR #482 in importer, monitoring alert rule M-118, KB update PR #79.
